heading: From a sentence to reviewable PRs.
description: Helix turns a single high-level prompt into an executable, verifiable plan — and ships it as small, reviewable diffs.

steps.title: Describe the goal
steps.description: Drop a prompt, a ticket, or a rough spec. Helix ingests intent — not implementation details — and scopes the work against your repository.

steps.title: Decompose into atoms
steps.description: Helix breaks the work into atomic, reviewable units. Each atom has explicit preconditions, a single goal, and the contracts it must satisfy.

steps.title: Apply, review, merge
steps.description: Agents execute atoms in dependency order. Every atom is gated on the surrounding repo: type-check, tests, lint, and contract assertions must all pass.

steps.title: Ship with confidence
steps.description: Output is a stream of small, reviewable PRs — auditable, replayable, and easy to merge. You stay in control of what reaches main.
